key.name: bar-smoke
key.description: How much the top bar is darkened behind its white text: 'none', 'light' (30%), 'medium' (45%, passes WCAG AA over a bright wallpaper) or 'heavy' (60%).

key.name: bar-text-shadow
key.description: A soft shadow under the text and icons of the top bar, to keep their edges crisp over a busy background.

key.name: popovers
key.description: Give menus, the calendar and notification banners the tinted glass material.
